purpose: Read-only reconciliation of every pending XLS/XLSB coverage row against the finalized native Excel corpus and bounded Computer Use observations.

provenance.selection: All rows with format xls or xlsb and fixture_status=pending at audit time
provenance.office_ui_controller: Root agent; this audit did not operate Office UI.

classification_semantics.operation_only: The row describes a library CRUD/codec/transaction/refresh/publish/runtime behavior that a native saved file cannot certify. A native target may provide source bytes, but it does not close the operation claim.
classification_semantics.observed_native_ui_limitation: The tested native Excel UI exposed no usable route or a disabled control for the exact family. This is session-scoped route evidence and never a global feature-absence claim.
classification_semantics.external_handoff: The row requires an external password, certificate identity, provider/server, add-in, or custom authoring tool before a bounded native probe can be authoritative.
classification_semantics.genuinely_missing_authorable_family: No exact saved-state family is present in the finalized corpus and no stronger blocker classification is justified. A candidate native target is listed when a feasible route is known; absence is not inferred from unfamiliarity.

closed_native_families.bounded_evidence: The native specimen contains 17 embedded chart families, chart caches/axes/error-bars/trendlines, 18 worksheet/drawing resources, SVG plus raster fallback, BIFF12 chart resources, and 17 BIFF8 chart substreams. XLS retains the chart substreams and rasterizes the SVG. This closes the listed stored-family scope only; rendering, complete chart authoring, recalculation, and runtime remain boundaries.

The three native derivatives retain the legacy Text connection, Microsoft.Mashup.OleDb.1 query connection, query-table metadata, loaded rows, and DataMashup payload. XLSX Connections::parse and XLSB Workbook::connections pass; XLSB text wizard detail remains raw and XLS direct worksheet publication is suppressed. No connection CRUD, refresh, or external execution claim follows.

Native Excel reopened with workbook-local 1904 mode, cached date/formula serials, manual page-break families, print area, hidden state, and two custom views. XLSB exposes the 1904 flag and numeric values while page breaks/custom views remain raw; XLS workbook metadata exposes the date system/custom views but its worksheet catalog is empty. Native date rendering and print/custom-view application remain untested.

The native files retain 11 lower-ribbon Form Controls with linked values and option-group state. XLSB exposes inert DrawingML/VML/package records without a typed control API; XLS raw BIFF8 has all 11 Obj records while the typed reader projects 8 and records DropDown/List/Button boundaries. ActiveX, VBA, macro assignment, and interaction runtime are not claimed.

Native files retain CSE/array, shared, one-variable/two-variable data-table, Scenario Manager, dynamic-array owners and cached values. Raw XLSB records parse but the unified reader stops at BrtName shortcut key 0x00; XLS retains caches/owners but renders native LET as =#VALUE! while cache 50 remains. No recalculation or scenario/data-table runtime claim follows.

native_ui_observations.observation: The bounded native UI probe exposed VB/macros/Form Controls but no XML Maps, Data Model, or Power Pivot control. This is a route-availability observation for the tested Excel session, not a global absence claim.

Tools exposes Track Changes > Highlight Changes… and Accept or Reject Changes…; Merge Workbooks is visible but disabled. A fresh small revision-history workbook remains a feasible next native probe, subject to whether Track Changes activation is accepted and persists in the selected XLS/XLSB save.
No document-signing command was exposed in the bounded File/Tools probe. A signing fixture still requires a certificate/private-key identity and trust workflow outside this audit.

xls_native_core_state.kind: bounded native raw/package evidence plus reader boundaries
xls_native_core_state.evidence: The finalized XLS corpus contains valid CFB containers and native Workbook streams with ordinary cells, formulas/caches, dates, names, styles, protection, validation, notes, controls, charts, connections and custom XML. Those saved bytes support format-specific observations, but do not by themselves certify the library read/write/transaction surface for the pending generic rows. XLS worksheet publication is suppressed for several derivatives, so public facade emptiness is not treated as native absence.

xlsb_native_core_state.kind: bounded native raw/package evidence plus reader boundaries
xlsb_native_core_state.evidence: The finalized XLSB corpus contains workbook/worksheet/index/style/shared-string/drawing/chart/control/connection parts and native caches. Typed readers pass or stop at recorded native record families such as AC_BEGIN in BrtBeginDVals and the formula-owner BrtName shortcut; raw package evidence remains valid. Generic package/codec/CRUD rows require operation evidence beyond a native saved file.

xls_future_records.evidence: Unknown/future BIFF records cannot be selected as a deterministic native Excel UI feature. Existing native files contain known record families and opaque/extension records, but no fixture can claim an intentionally authored future record.

xls_password_handoff.evidence: No finalized native password-to-open XLS fixture is present. Creating and verifying one requires a user-supplied password and a reopen/decryption handoff; workbook protection in interaction-print.xls is not package encryption.

legacy_signing_handoff.evidence: No finalized native signed XLS/XLSB fixture is present. The bounded File/Tools probe exposed no signing command, and certificate/private-key identity and trust are external prerequisites.

xls_custom_xml.evidence: excel-connections.xls contains one MsoDataStore storage with a 11,106-byte DataMashup Item and 314-byte Properties stream; Workbook::custom_xml_data_store reports one DataMashup item. This is native custom-XML storage evidence for the Power Query subtype, not arbitrary XML-map/custom XML authoring.

xls_macro_dialog.evidence: No finalized XLS fixture contains a deliberately authored macro sheet or dialog sheet. The matrix only promises metadata recognition; formula execution, dialog controls, and host automation are outside the saved-state fixture scope.

xls_crud_operation.evidence: Cell/worksheet CRUD is a library transaction surface. Native files show ordinary saved cells and sheet directories, but no Office reopen can certify litchi-xls insertion, removal, rename, or atomic publication behavior.

xls_picture.evidence: The conditional-drawings and visual fixtures contain worksheet pictures/shapes, but no finalized XLS fixture isolates a BIFF8 background or header/footer picture record. A dedicated saved-state specimen is therefore still absent.

xls_watch.evidence: No finalized XLS fixture records a native Watch Window entry or formula-error checking state. The matrix exposes inert CellWatch/error metadata and does not implement the watch-window/diagnostic runtime.

xls_phonetic.evidence: No finalized XLS fixture isolates BIFF8 phonetic string/range metadata. Authoring requires an East Asian language/phonetic UI context; no such context was established by this audit.

xls_consolidation.evidence: No finalized XLS fixture contains a dedicated consolidation directory/source set. Native Data > Consolidate could produce a saved state, but the library matrix explicitly treats consolidation as inert metadata and does not execute it.

xls_web_publish.evidence: No finalized XLS fixture certifies publishing. The matrix models publication destinations/ranges/page metadata but explicitly excludes publishing and network I/O; a Save As Web Page operation would be separate evidence.

xls_rtd.evidence: No finalized XLS fixture contains an RTD server/ProgID/topic setup. A native RTD result requires an external server/provider; the library retains topics and cached values inertly and does not refresh or execute them.

revision_history.kind: operation-only with a feasible native route
revision_history.evidence: No finalized XLS/XLSB fixture contains a saved revision log/user-name collaboration state. The current native Tools menu exposes Track Changes > Highlight Changes… and Accept or Reject Changes…; Merge Workbooks is disabled. Menu presence is not saved-state evidence, so a fresh small workbook probe is still needed.

xls_toolbar.evidence: No finalized XLS fixture contains an intentionally authored XCB Office Toolbars stream. The matrix supports inert typed toolbar metadata, but this audit did not establish a native Excel route for creating a deterministic legacy toolbar customization.

dde_external.evidence: No finalized XLS/XLSB fixture performs DDE/OLE conversation, COM activation, refresh, or external launch. The matrix retains link topics/program IDs/items as inert metadata; an external program/provider would be required for runtime evidence.

mdx_external.evidence: No finalized XLS/XLSB fixture uses a cube connection or MDX provider. The matrix exposes bounded MDX/cell/value metadata but explicitly does not execute cube connections or MDX expressions.

xml_maps_ui.evidence: The bounded Developer/Tools probe exposed no XML Maps command for the tested Excel session. Existing evidence must not be promoted to a global absence claim; an alternate Excel edition/add-in or an external XML mapping authoring route would be needed to test it.

xlsb_volatile.evidence: No finalized XLSB fixture contains an optional Volatile Dependencies part. The matrix owns bounded part/record transactions, but no stable native Excel UI action was identified that deterministically authors this family.

xlsb_crud_operation.evidence: Worksheet cell CRUD and generic OPC part editing are library transactions. Native XLSB package saves and binary indexes prove source structure only; they do not certify litchi-xlsb edit/commit/patch behavior.

threaded_comments.evidence: The finalized Excel corpus contains classic notes but no XLSB threaded-comment/persons parts or reply evidence. A native Review > New Comment/reply specimen is a concrete candidate; no such operation was performed in this audit.

xlsb_watch_phonetic.evidence: No finalized XLSB fixture contains cell-watch or phonetic metadata. A Watch Window specimen is a feasible candidate; phonetic metadata additionally needs the appropriate language/IME context. Rendering and watch monitoring remain outside the matrix.

data_model_ui.evidence: The bounded Developer/Tools probe exposed no Data Model or Power Pivot control for the tested Excel session. This records route availability only; it does not establish that all Excel editions lack the feature.

xlsb_ribbon_external.evidence: No finalized XLSB package contains custom Ribbon UI. Native Excel menu probing did not establish a custom UI authoring route; a bounded Custom UI package/editor handoff would be required before native behavior can be assessed.

xlsb_taskpane_external.evidence: No finalized XLSB package contains a task-pane/web-extension binding. The matrix supports bounded graph metadata but excludes add-in activation/provider behavior; an add-in/web-provider handoff is required for runtime evidence.

xls_legacy_core_bundle.route: Create one small ordinary workbook in native Excel, add values/formulas, merged cells, styles, names, hyperlink, validation, view/protection/property markers, then Save As Excel 97-2004 Workbook (.xls) and close/reopen.
xls_legacy_core_bundle.limit: This would add native saved-state evidence only. It cannot close library transaction/CRUD claims by itself; all CFB/BIFF records and typed reader results must remain separately bounded.

xls_legacy_macro_dialog.route: If the tested Excel edition exposes Insert Macro Sheet or Insert Dialog Sheet, create one marker-bearing legacy sheet and save as .xls.
xls_legacy_macro_dialog.limit: The route is a candidate and was not observed; macro formulas/dialog controls must remain inert and unexecuted.

xls_background_header_picture.route: Use Page Layout > Background and Insert Header & Footer > Picture in a small workbook, save as .xls, close/reopen, and inspect BIFF8 background/header picture records.
xls_background_header_picture.limit: Background and header/footer pictures are separate authoring paths; a worksheet drawing picture does not substitute for either one.

xls_watch_window.route: Create a formula marker, use Formulas > Watch Window to add it and the native error-checking controls if available, then save/reopen the legacy derivative.
xls_watch_window.limit: The native watch display/runtime is not a library claim; only persisted metadata should be recorded.

xls_phonetic_language.route: With an East Asian editing language/IME available, author phonetic/ruby text and save as .xls; inspect the BIFF8 phonetic records.
xls_phonetic_language.limit: No language/IME route was established in this audit, so this remains a candidate rather than an observed native limitation.

xls_data_consolidate.route: Use Data > Consolidate over two local ranges, save as .xls, and inspect the saved consolidation directory/source metadata.
xls_data_consolidate.limit: Do not treat the native result as evidence of library execution; the matrix keeps consolidation inert.

xls_save_as_web.route: Use Save As Web Page with a local destination and record the publication settings/output as an operation-specific artifact.
xls_save_as_web.limit: Publishing/network behavior is outside this fixture-only audit and would need a separate operation receipt.

revision_history_small.route: Create a small marker workbook; use Tools > Track Changes > Highlight Changes… to enable tracking, edit one marker, save as XLS and XLSB, close/reopen, and inspect revision-log/user-name records. Test Accept or Reject separately. Merge Workbooks is currently disabled.
revision_history_small.limit: The menu route is observed, but activation/persistence and the legacy shared-workbook prerequisites remain unverified.

xls_toolbar_customization.route: If native Excel exposes a legacy Customize Toolbar route, add one deterministic toolbar marker and save as .xls for XCB inspection.
xls_toolbar_customization.limit: No such route was observed in the current bounded probe; do not infer global absence.

xlsb_threaded_comments.route: Use Review > New Comment, add a reply/mention if the native session exposes threaded comments, save as XLSB, close/reopen, and inspect comments/persons relationships.
xlsb_threaded_comments.limit: The existing classic-note fixture does not substitute for a threaded comment; no threaded operation was performed.

xlsb_watch_phonetic.route: Use Formula > Watch Window for a marker formula and, with an East Asian language/IME available, author phonetic text; save as XLSB and inspect the BIFF12 metadata.
xlsb_watch_phonetic.limit: The two subfamilies need separate saved-state observations; no watch monitoring or phonetic rendering claim follows.

XML maps and mapped XML import/export
OPC package and BIFF12 part graph
Spreadsheet Data Model records and model part
